title: 污泥帶濾式脫水
summary: 本課以重力排水、楔形壓榨與帶面負荷為主線，從進料乾固體、調理與藥劑活性、重力排水接觸、帶寬固體負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops gravity drainage, wedge pressing and belt loading through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry solids, conditioning and active polymer, gravity-drainage contact, solids per belt width. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.instruction: 跨污泥種類比較單一乾度造成錯誤選型。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing cake solids across different sludges misguides selection. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
steps.failure: 跨污泥種類比較單一乾度造成錯誤選型。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.failureEn: Comparing cake solids across different sludges misguides selection. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「整體穩態交接」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-system steady-state handoff. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.text: 跨污泥種類比較單一乾度造成錯誤選型。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing cake solids across different sludges misguides selection. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「整體穩態交接」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using whole-system steady-state handoff, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
